requirement.statement: The system SHALL define Eidolon-native workflow package boundaries so contracts, tools, effects and profile enablement have separate owners.

case.given: Workflow becomes a native Eidolon capability
case.when: The integration defines shared workflow state and data-subgraph contracts
case.then: The contracts SHALL live in a dedicated workflow contract package rather than being hidden inside tool implementation code

case.when: The tool source files are placed
case.then: The implementation SHALL live under the workflow tools directory, with AIAgent composer code limited to bundle registration

case.given: Workflow node effects need host runtime adapters
case.when: The effect handler source files are placed
case.then: The implementation SHALL live under the workflow effects directory and remain scheduler-facing

requirement.statement: The system SHALL expose first-party workflow operations as native Eidolon tools, including both runtime control and authoring workspace operations.

case.given: An AI agent needs to operate a workflow run
case.when: It asks to start, inspect, resume, patch or promote a workflow run
case.then: The native workflow tool surface SHALL provide stable tool definitions for those operations

case.given: An AI agent needs to edit workflow resources in an authoring workspace
case.when: It asks to create, patch, validate or inspect workflow definitions, app bundle resources, material ports, material bindings or RunGraph patches
case.then: The native workflow tool surface SHALL provide first-class authoring tools rather than requiring MCP-only functions

requirement.statement: The system SHALL keep workflow effect handlers internal to the workflow scheduler and map them onto existing Eidolon runtime mechanisms.

case.given: A workflow node represents an AI agent task
case.then: The runtime SHALL use existing actor, fiber, delegate and detached task mechanisms instead of a workflow-specific actor/session runtime

case.given: A workflow node invokes a tool-like effect
case.then: The runtime SHALL execute through existing tool registry and actor turn machinery so tool-call facts and runtime-control evidence remain authoritative

case.given: An internal workflow effect handler exists
case.when: The model-visible native tool list is built
case.then: The handler SHALL NOT be exposed directly as an AI-callable tool

requirement.statement: The system SHALL persist only workflow-owned orchestration facts and reference Eidolon-owned runtime facts by stable identifiers.

case.given: A workflow run graph changes over time
case.when: The workflow persistence layer records state
case.then: It SHALL store definitions, RunGraph structure, node generations, invalidation/reuse policy, material bindings, node status refs, graph patch/promote records and workflow audit decisions

case.given: A workflow node creates actor, conversation, tool, provider, checkpoint, mailbox, member, holon or detached-task state
case.when: The workflow records the node result
case.then: It SHALL store references to Eidolon-owned facts rather than duplicating their state

case.given: An Eidolon session is restored from durable state
case.then: The workflow SHALL reconcile node refs against restored actor, fiber, task and domain facts before continuing scheduling
